properties.note: Pre-reaction complex: cis(Z)-HN=NH + C2H4 in one non-covalent complex (single Gaussian job, opt+freq, 0 imaginary frequencies, normal termination). Lowest-energy verified reactant-complex minimum in the project evidence (a second, 2.6 kcal higher conformer is work/concerted/RC_seed_optfreq.log at -189.094517955).
properties.method: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP (B3LYP/def2SVP EmpiricalDispersion=GD3BJ), Gaussian 16, gas phase, charge 0, singlet

properties.note: Concerted synchronous double H transfer; symmetric six-membered-ring-like TS, r(H3-C5)=r(H4-C6)=1.687 A, r(N1-H3)=1.130, r(N2-H4)=1.129, r(N1-N2)=1.197, r(C5-C6)=1.371 A. Exactly one imaginary frequency (-449.4 cm-1) with both H...C pairs carrying the mode equally (pair projections 3-5 = 0.860, 4-6 = 0.860).
properties.irc_note: IRC (calcfc) from this TS, work/concerted/IRC_TS1_lowres.log: reverse branch (12 points) ends at E = -189.094543 Ha = the RC complex region (straddling conformer work/concerted/RC_seed_optfreq.log, -189.094517955); forward branch (25 points, point limit) descends to E = -189.205983 Ha on the N2 + C2H6 side. Direction of the connection is therefore RC -> N2 + C2H6.

irc_endpoint_a.note: Reverse IRC outer frame re-optimized (opt+freq, 0 imaginary frequencies, normal termination) = the cis-diimide + C2H4 pre-reaction complex minimum (r(H3-C5)=r(H4-C6)~2.03 A, N1-N2 1.22, C5-C6 1.35).

irc_endpoint_b.note: Forward IRC outer frame displaced 60 deg off the floppy N2-ethane libration and re-optimized unconstrained (0 imaginary frequencies, normal termination) = the N2 + C2H6 product-complex minimum, identical to node P (work/concerted/P2_optfreq.log) to 1e-9 Ha. Raw IRC endpoint energy -189.205983 Ha (work/concerted/IRC_TS1_lowres.log).

properties.note: Product state N2 + C2H6 in one complex (single Gaussian job, opt+freq, 0 imaginary frequencies, normal termination). An earlier product-complex optimization (work/concerted/P_optfreq.log) retained one -24.4 cm-1 intermolecular libration; this displaced-start re-optimization is the clean minimum.
properties.irc_endpoint_note: forward IRC endpoint -189.205983 Ha (work/concerted/IRC_TS1_lowres.log) is on the way to this product complex; P is the fully optimized N2 + C2H6 minimum.

properties.note: Extra pathway that was investigated and rejected: 1,2-diazetidine (four-membered ring N1-N2-C6-C5) is a genuine minimum (0 imaginary frequencies) only 2.3 kcal/mol below RC, but no first-order saddle connects it to either RC or P at this level (ring-closure ridge sampled +39 to +46 kcal/mol above RC; N-H -> C-H retro transfer is monotonic, >= +72 kcal/mol above INT). No elementary step is therefore attached to this node; see PROCESS.md and work/stepwise/REPORT.md.
